featured_reviews.name: Meghna Kaushik
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a very specific visa photo requirement and were unable to visit the studio in person. The team went above and beyond to help us through the entire process remotely. They guided us step by step on how to take the photo using our phone, edited it professionally, and patiently made multiple revisions until the visa agent finally approved it.

What impressed us most was their honesty, professionalism, and commitment to customer satisfaction. At every stage, they were responsive, transparent, and genuinely cared about getting the job done right rather than just completing a transaction.

It’s rare to find a business that combines technical expertise with such a customer-first attitude. Highly recommended for anyone looking for reliable and trustworthy photo services.

featured_reviews.name: Amey Vartak
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m incredibly happy with the service I received. They successfully converted a 35-year-old cassette for me, and the digital quality is excellent.

I am so grateful for the high-quality result and for the care they took with such a sentimental item. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: GOD IS ONE
featured_reviews.review_text:
Genuine hard work in one's job or business is more manifest than one's spoken words; it is like surrendering to one's work. I have experienced this in the quality results of different people's activities. One such experience was at Navin Surekha Photo Studio in Vile Parle East, very near the railway station. I had to convert my 41-year-old VHS video cassette to digital format. I was not sure that it would be converted to digital, but when I met Mr. Ojas bhai, the owner of the said photo studio, he assured me of a good result. And after two weeks of eager anticipation, I got surprisingly good results. Previously, 20-30 years ago i had converted this video cassette to CD quality from another shop, but its quality was not satisfactory to me. Thank God! My good luck was waiting for me to give a blissful experience from this result.
Though some old, unclean, fungus-damaged video scenes were not at a satisfactory level, most of the video results were very good compared to 40-year-old recordings and better than CD quality. So, thanks to Navin Surekha Studio, especially to Mr. Ojas, who gave me assured results. A very polite and good knowledgeable person. Thanks again!!🙏🏻

featured_reviews.name: Adv. Anushka Deshmukh Banavalikar
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a fantastic experience! Mr. Navin quickly completed my photo editing and framing in under 15 minutes. He also showcased incredible wedding albums, including one with a live video feature, which is truly innovative! The service was efficient, reliable, and top-notch. 👍📸

featured_reviews.name: Saisupriya Bhatt
featured_reviews.review_text:
It is truly hard to put into words how grateful we are for the beautiful work done by Roshan and Mayur. From the very first moment, they were not just photographers but felt like family—so kind, polite, warm, and incredibly comforting to be around.

Their professionalism, patience, and eye for detail reflected in every single moment they captured. The way they handled the entire shoot—with calmness, respect, and genuine care—made us feel completely at ease during such an emotional and sacred time.

One moment that will stay in our hearts forever is when Roshan so lovingly agreed to step into the role of my brother during the rituals. That gesture went far beyond duty or professionalism—it was pure warmth and humanity. It made the rituals feel even more meaningful, emotional, and complete, and it created a memory we will cherish for a lifetime.

Roshan and Mayur carry such beautiful, positive vibes, and it truly reflects in their work. Their presence added joy, comfort, and grace to our wedding, and the results speak for themselves—simply amazing.

Thank you both for not just capturing our wedding, but for becoming a part of it. We will always remember you with immense gratitude and love. 😊❤️🙏✨

featured_reviews.name: Gavin Gomes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Choosing Flashbacks for our wedding photography and videography was hands down one of the best decisions we made for our big day. From our pre-wedding to post-wedding celebrations, they were with us every step of the way — and every single moment was captured with artistry, heart, and precision.
From our very first interaction to the final delivery of our photos and videos, the entire process was smooth, professional, and incredibly efficient. After selecting our favorite photographs, we received our beautifully crafted albums within just two weeks — a level of turnaround and quality that truly impressed us.
A special mention goes to Masban Pereira, whom we would recommend without hesitation. He is a rare talent — deeply passionate about his craft, meticulous in detail, and genuinely invested in capturing the essence of your day. He didn’t just take photos; he told our love story with every frame.
Masban and his team have an almost magical ability to be everywhere at once without ever feeling intrusive. They anticipated moments before they even happened and captured candid emotions and fleeting glances that we didn’t even realize were happening amidst the joyful chaos. Looking back at the gallery felt like reliving every single heartbeat of our wedding.
The final images brought us to tears. Each photograph was filled with life, love, and light. The editing was beautifully natural, the composition exquisite, and the attention to detail left us in absolute awe. These are not just photographs — they’re memories we will cherish for a lifetime.
To any couple looking for a team that will not only meet but exceed expectations — one that will make you feel at ease, understand your vision, and deliver pure, timeless magic — look no further than Flashbacks and Masban Pereira.
Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for giving us memories we’ll hold close forever.
With love and deep gratitude,
Gavin & Larisa
